digest.component_or_area: merge recovery toolkit across sync and push_recovery
propositions: Merge-abort recovery logic is duplicated across sync.py and push_recovery.py with divergent implementations of the quarantine mover

push_recovery._quarantine_untracked_paths includes a git status --porcelain check for untracked files that sync._quarantine_untracked lacks, causing identical bugs to manifest separately in both paths
sync.py and push_recovery.py cannot share the mover directly because push_recovery requires late-bound core._git seam while sync uses module-level _git
A new merge_recovery.py module consolidates the recovery toolkit with a single untracked-fence-guarded mover accepting git as a callable parameter to support both call sites

The shared mover and parser must be extracted into one documented owner while preserving backward-compatible thin adapters in sync.py and push_recovery.py to maintain existing monkeypatch points in tests and doctor.py
